::: {#def-intervention .theorem}
## Intervention equation

A deterministic function $h_{X_{ki}}$ that returns a value in the range of the random variable $X_{ki}$ from the [covariates](#def-covariate) preceding it in a [topological order](#def-dag) of the [NPSEM](#def-npsem), and from the elements of its own covariate that precede it:

$$
h_{X_{ki}} : \mathcal{R}(\mathbf X_1) \times \dots \times \mathcal{R}(\mathbf X_{k-1}) \times \mathcal{R}(\mathbf X_{k,<i}) \to \mathcal{R}(X_{ki}),
$$

where $\mathcal{R}(\cdot)$ is the range. The arguments are measured variables; the error term $U_{X_{ki}}$ is not among them.
:::
